Technical 
 Directives
Introduction

This instrument is used for measuring the sound level in different sites in 
 the station, this measurement must be performed every one week.

The first draft 
initiated by Chemist: 
 Gihan Abd Elsamee Elsaiad; 
reviewed by department director Chemist 
Maha.M.S Hamoda; 
revised by quality control chemist: 
Wael A. Tantawy at EDEPC,
and accepted by eng. 
Awad Mohammed 
 Fathy; Head sector of Talkha power station, 
and certified by eng. Aly Mostafa Al Lethy EDEPC inspection & quality control 
head sector.
Information
Features
Large LCD display, easy to read.

Frequency weighting networks A&C weighting & Time weighting (Fast/Slow) are 
 designed to meet the IEC651 type 1
AC output for system expansion.
Build in CALIBRATION VR on front panel.
Changeable condenser microphone for high accuracy & long term stability.
Max. Hold function for stored the maximum value on display.
Build max. hold reset switch.
Warning indicator for over and under load.

LCD display for low power consumption & clear read out even in bright ambient 
 light condition.

Used the durable, long lasting components, including a strong, light weight 
 ABS plastic housing case.
Low battery indicator.

Characteristics of A & C.
A weighting
The characteristic is simulated as "Human Ear listing" response. Typical, if making the environmental sound level measurement, always select to A weighting.
C weighting

The characteristic is near the "FLAT" Response. Typical, it is suitable for checking the noise of 
 machinery (Q.C.check) & knowing the sound pressure level of the tested 
 equipment.

Slow (S): t = 500 ms

The instrument is provided an 3.5 mm Dia. "Phone signal output terminal" (

Replacement of Battery

When the left corner of LCD display show "BAT ", it is necessary to replace 
 the battery. However, in spec. measurement may still be made for several 
 hours after "Low battery indicator" appears before the instrument become 
 inaccurate.

Slide the "Battery Cover" in Fig.1 & take the battery away from the 
 battery compartment.
Replace with 2 PCs 9V battery (heavy duty type) and reinstate the cover.

sections.text: Calibration

The sound level meter is built in the internal calibration "Calibration VR" 
 ( Calibration VR (Accuracy adjust VR), Fig.1) on the front panel. Please according the following procedures to 
 calibrate the instrument accurately, if it is necessary.
Calibrated via External SOUND CALIBRATOR

1.
 Prepare the optional "SOUND CALIBRATOR" such as "SC940 A" or "SC941". Power 
 on the Sound Calibrator & plug calibrator output into the" Electric 
condenser microphone " head in Fig.1 of the Sound Level Meter.
2. Slide the "Range Selector" in Fig.1 to " 60100 dB " position.

3.
 Slide "Time Weighting Selector" in Fig.1 to " F " position.

4. Slide the "A/C Weighting Selector " in Fig.1 to "A 
 weighting" position.

5. Carefully adjust the "Calibration VR" ( 
 Calibration VR (Accuracy adjust VR), Fig.1) with"" 
 screw driver (include accessory), until the display read within " 94.0 + 
 0.2 " dB.

Calibrated via Internal 94 dB 
Generator

Sound level meter is 
 built in the internal standard 94 dB/1 KHz square wave generator for the 
 purpose to calibrate come certain amplifier circuit ( not the complete meter system). Please according the following procedures to calibrate the 
 instrument before making operation, if the instrument not in use for a long 
 time.

The calibration method are similar as above in 
Calibrated via External SOUND CALIBRATOR, but not connect the 
 external sound calibrator (SC941A, SC941...), the other should slide 
 "Power off / On / Internal calibration selector" in Fig.1 to the "CAL. "position". 
 Carefully adjust the "Calibration VR" position "VR" ( Calibration VR 
 (Accuracy adjust VR), Fig.1 ) with " " 
 screw driver (included accessory), until the display read within " 94.0 + 
 0.2 " dB.
NOTE 3

If intend to make calibration accurately of whole meter, it is 
 recommended to use the calibrating procedures of "Calibrated via External 
 SOUND CALIBRATOR.
